text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Today was— 
a bit of an exhausting day...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's already completely dark 
outside————

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back home, whenever this happened... 
all I had to do was look up, and there'd 
be so many stars—...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact couldn't help 
but find herself longing for the skies of 
her hometown.
